comment: A Silo arms a Nuclear Missile and a Ghost calls it on the ground in its sight; while the missile rises the Ghost cancels (Escape, Cancel Nuke 0x2e 0x4724f0, 0x435a40): the missile without its link dies before its descent (NukeLaunch 125 0x436540) and the Ghost's tracking ends with its dot (NukeTrack 129 0x436720). The Silo arms a second missile, and a trigger kills the Silo with it ready: the missile dies with its Silo (TeardownUnitTypeLinks 0x4253a0).
